goal: Prevent identical address announcements from falsely passing the freshness check when relayed across peers
Stop duplicate gossip announcements from artificially inflating an address's multiplicity in the new table
agreement: Blocked by an open objection on correctness with no author reply yet
Unaddressed objection: check ordering blocks genuinely newer announcements when refresh fires (taki-abedesselam)
Support because it prevents unwarranted reference count inflation on onion and I2P nodes (stratospher)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes a logic bug that allows duplicate gossip relays to artificially inflate address counts
Adversarial impact is minimal because attackers can easily bypass it by varying announcement timestamps
